extension.description: Automatically track movies and TV shows you watch in Kodi on your WeTrakr profile. Marks content as watched, syncs your viewing activity in real-time.
extension.news:
v1.3.1 - Your WeTrakr lists in Kodi: pick lists in wetrakr.com > Settings > Kodi and the movies and shows you have get a 'WeTrakr: list name' tag, with a smart playlist in Videos > Playlists for skin widgets. Plan to Watch gets its playlist too. - Fix: a library clean or re-scan could make a new item inherit the sync state of an old one.
v1.3.0 - Two-way library sync with WeTrakr: watched (with dates), ratings and resume points both ways; manual marks in Kodi are sent instantly; Plan to Watch titles get the 'WeTrakr Watchlist' tag. Runs in the background, never during playback. Settings > Library sync. - Movies played from video add-ons without ids are matched by the ids in the add-on URL, or by title, year and duration.
v1.2.2 - Send the library scraper (TheTVDB or TMDB) and the episode air date with episode scrobbles, so WeTrakr can match shows that TheTVDB and TMDB number differently (e.g. The Great British Bake Off: season 17 on TheTVDB, season 10 on TMDB).
